name: Conformance: Replay Side-Effect Suppression
description: RFC 0140 fixture for `replay-side-effect-suppression.test.ts`. A `core.delay` gate followed by a node the host classifies as SIDE-EFFECTING. The test starts a run, cancels it mid-delay so the effect node never reaches a terminal outcome, then forks `mode:"replay"` — a host advertising `replay.sideEffectSuppression: "recorded-outcome"` MUST fail that node closed with `replay_source_missing` (replay.md §"Side-effect suppression in replay" requirement 3) rather than executing it. `core.conformance.side-effect` is a conformance-RESERVED typeId (same pattern as `core.conformance.mock-agent`): a host advertising the capability MUST map it to a node its replay classifier treats as side-effecting. The node's actual effect is irrelevant to the assertion — what matters is that the host would refuse to perform it during a replay. Hosts that do not advertise the capability need not supply this fixture; the scenario skips.

variables.name: delayMs
variables.description: Sleep duration before the side-effecting node (1..60000 ms). The test sets this long enough to cancel mid-flight so `effect` never records a terminal outcome.
